```python
def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):
    return upscale(grid, len({v for row in grid for v in row}) - 1)
```

[]
background - The most common color in the grid.
majority_color - The most common color excluding the given ones.
rare_color - The least common color excluding the given ones.
bbox - (top, left, bottom, right) of the non-background cells; None if none.
full_rows - Indices of rows that are entirely the given color.
full_cols - Indices of columns that are entirely the given color.
cells_of - Set of (row, col) of all cells of the given color.
draw_line - Draw a full row ('h') or column ('v') line at the given index on grid out.
blit_color - Paint each (r, c) of cells shifted by (dr, dc) with color.
hmirror - The grid mirrored left to right.
vflip - The grid flipped top to bottom.
hstack - The two grids side by side; they must have the same height.
vstack - The grids stacked top to bottom; they must have the same width.
draw_border - Color every background cell on the border of the non-background cells' bounding box, keeping marked cells.
fill_line_gaps - Fill background cells sandwiched between two marked (non-background, non-color) cells in their row or column; with continue_line, only when the marked line continues on one side two cells away.
mark - Fill background cells that lie between a non-background cell on their left and one on their right in the same row.
fall_down - The whole non-background content shifted down one row; whatever falls off the bottom is lost.
downsample_majority - Each factor x factor block as its most common color that is neither 0 nor the background, or 0 if it has none; factor defaults to side // number of distinct colors.
fill_ring_interiors - Fill the inside of every closed rectangular ring (hollow rectangle) with the given color.
extend_diagonal_runs - Complete every diagonal run of two or more same-colored cells whose diagonal also holds a different color: extend it through background cells to the border or the next cell.
line_runs - Group cells into two parallel runs of >=2 sharing a row or column; returns (runs, horiz) or (None, None).
paired_beam_fill - Two parallel marker runs and seed cells: each seed beams toward its run's cell (seed becomes `junction`),
stamp_marker_motif - Stamp the grid's small multi-color motif centered on every isolated noise dot.
concave_twin_recolor - Recolor to the L-stroke color the shape-twin of the component nested in the L's concave corner.
comps - Cells non-zero in every patterned block, recolored; a single block maps to itself.
shared_color_mark - The two blocks split by a full separator line, marked where both blocks show the color they share; that shared color elsewhere.
fill_between_walls - Cells (all non-wall cells, or just those of color `only`) with a wall both above and below in their column, or both left and right in their row, become `fill`.
diagonal_bands_tile - Colored diagonal lines (each a band of constant i-j or i+j) extend: the whole grid is tiled by those bands' colors cycling with period = number of colors.
fill_regions_with_pattern - Copy the one non-uniform region's content into every region of the grid, keeping the uniform separator lines.
fill_rect_holes - Fill every background region enclosed except via the given open borders, if it is a solid rectangle that is either fully walled or at least 2 columns wide, with color `new`.
recolor_small_to_large_zero - The smaller of the grid's two colors becomes the larger, and the larger becomes 0.
fill_bounding_boxes - Keep large same-color components as solid rectangles: fill each component of at least min_size cells with its color over its bounding box, and turn every other non-background cell into the background color.
recolor_lines - Every cell in a single-color row or column (optionally of one given color) becomes `new`.
tile_rotations_quadrants - The grid tiled 2x2: top-left as-is, top-right rotated 90 clockwise, bottom-right 180, bottom-left 270.
stamp_shape_on_fitting_spots - Find the shape drawn in `color` and stamp copies everywhere it fits entirely on background cells.
corner_blocks - Split the grid by rows/columns carrying rare marker colors; each lattice block gets color c if all 4 corner markers are c, else the fill color.
complete_deficient_copy - Copies of a multi-row pattern block (or left-anchored pattern bars): each deficient copy is completed from the most complete one, marking missing cells `mark`.
pc_count - Counts of color in each separator-delimited block, as a grid of counts.
l_stroke - Find the L-shaped stroke (two perpendicular runs sharing a corner cell): (its color, its cells as a set).
pattern_blocks - The patterned sub-blocks of the grid, split by uniform lines of separator colors (colors appearing only in uniform lines).
regions_between_lines - All (row-span, col-span) regions of the grid separated by its uniform non-background lines.
enclosed_regions - The connected regions of background cells that do not touch the given grid borders: lists of (row, col).
components - The 4-connected components of cells of the given color, as lists of (row, col).
rotate_cw - The grid rotated 90 degrees clockwise k times.
pattern_row_blocks - The contiguous blocks of rows that contain the pattern color pc (background bg).
one_color_lines - Indices of rows (axis=0) or columns (axis=1) that are a single color throughout; both if axis is None.
uniform_lines - Indices of the rows and columns that are uniform and non-zero (all uniform lines if include_zero).
is_solid_rect - The grid rotated 180 degrees.
index_runs - A sorted index list as its contiguous runs.
blocks - The maximal [start, end) spans of 0..n separated by the sorted separator indices.
rotate_ccw - The grid rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise k times.
count_color - How many cells of the grid equal color.
shift_down - Shift every row down by one; the new top row is filled with the given (default most common) color, and the last row is dropped.
downscale_block - Each block x block cell replaced by the block's single non-background color, else 0 (majority-color downscale).
recolor_full_lines - Every row and every column that is one solid color throughout is recolored to the given color.
transpose - The grid with rows and columns exchanged.
vflip - The grid mirrored top to bottom.
hflip - The grid mirrored left to right.
rot180 - The grid rotated by 180 degrees.
quadrant_kaleidoscope - The 2n x 2n grid whose quadrants are the grid, the flipped transpose (both ways), and the 180-degree rotation.
repeat_bands_vertically - Each colored single-row band repeats vertically with period = number of colored bands (row kept mod that period).
binarize - The grid with the most common color (or given bg) mapped to 1 and every other color to 0.
pivot_map - Cells of the pivot color take the value of the grid's other pivot-excluded color; every other color becomes fill.
fill_between_markers - Cells strictly between consecutive non-background (marker) cells in each row and column become fill; other cells unchanged.
period_phase_rows - Every row filled with the color of the colored row at the same phase mod the smallest period making colored rows distinct.
components8 - The 8-connected components of cells of the given color, as lists of (row, col).
wave_fill_right - Zigzag wave of marker runs: merge components joined by one diagonal bg gap (dr=1, dc=2); each row whose rightmost marker column equals its component's max column fills bg cells to the right edge with `fill` -- solid if the marker extends left of the tip or the cell directly above the tip is a marker, else every other column.
find - Fill the whole grid with the periodic stripe coloring implied by its nonzero cells: colors lie on parallel (main or anti) diagonals repeating with some period.
fill_box_interiors - Fill the interior of every closed rectangle of a single frame color with fill.
solid_lines - Indices of full rows and full columns that are one nonzero color throughout: ('r', i) / ('c', j).
overlap_half - Split the grid at the solid separator line that leaves two equal halves; cells nonzero in both halves become color.
recolor_scatter_to_bg - Each cell of the scattered (minority) color takes the background (majority) color, and the background becomes 0.
shift_colors_down - Sorted distinct colors shift down one rank: the smallest becomes 0, each other color becomes the next smaller one.
remap_min_to_zero - The grid with its smallest nonzero color mapped to 0 and the other colors shifted one rank down.
demote_minority - Color base (default 5) becomes the grid's other color, and that other color becomes 0.
